THE_EIGHTH_FACT.the_eighth: FIDELITY — of the fields the L0 schema authors, how many reach the mesh or the symbol.
THE_EIGHTH_FACT.why_the_seven_cannot_see_it: Every one of the seven is a PRESENCE test. `renders_3d = YES` is true of a mesh that is the wrong colour, the wrong size, missing its voids and drawn from catalogue defaults. The 2026-08-29 pass said so in its own words: '21 → 21 (renders 3D) … What this number hides is FIDELITY, not presence: roof drops materialId/materialColor through the bridge and still counts YES, because the seven-fact chain has no fidelity axis.' This phase supplies that axis.
THE_EIGHTH_FACT.definition_used: FIDELITY = YES only when every field the L0 element schema authors either (a) reaches the builder, or (b) is explicitly refused or announced at runtime. A field silently defaulted, silently renamed away, or read only by unreachable code is FIDELITY = NO.

REFUTATIONS_THIS_PHASE_OWES_ITSELF: The brief's headline case — 'roof dropping materialId and materialColor while counting renders_3d = YES' — IS CLOSED at this head, in all three legs (emit, mirror, builder). Verified, not assumed.
'liftPart has none [no builder]' — it has no builder OF ITS OWN and IS drawn, by its parent, from ev.parts[]. Stated as 'no builder' it reads as 'undrawn', which is wrong.
'pool draws the water body only' — pool draws FOUR members (water, basin walls, floor slab, host-slab void); it is the compound that has no mesh, correctly and by declaration.
'lift draws the cabin only' — the compound draws cabin, steel frame AND guide rails, and a SECOND, deliberately separate builder draws the LOD-200 massing lift.

A field-name grep scored window's six reveal fields at ZERO in WindowBuilder.ts and would have reported them never drawn. FALSE — every read is encapsulated in resolveWindowReveal (WindowBuilder.ts:839). Grep silence, cause three.

PlumbingFragmentBuilder.updateFixture appeared, on a partial read of :49-59, to build a mesh and never add it to the root. FALSE — :84 root.add(mesh). Reading a fragment of an implementation produced a wrong conclusion; reading the whole function refuted it. (The disposal finding in the same file survives, and was measured, not inferred.)

Lighting has no *PlanSymbolBuilder CLASS, so a class-name grep reports its plan symbol ABSENT. It is a store-driven pass instead (LightingPlanSymbolRenderer.renderLightingSymbols). ViewDependencyTracker.ts:97-107 records the identical discovery.

NOT_A_RECOMMENDATION: This phase proposes no fix. It records one hazard for whoever does: 'wire the committers' and 'widen the CEB emit' are RIVAL remedies for the same symptoms, and applying both would mint a third geometry path. boundaryLine already demonstrates a third option — a narrow event plus a store read — that costs nothing and loses nothing.
